PLAN "12-Week Strength Return for Post-Meniscus Tear"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Regain lower body and overall strength for skiing"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation & Mobility" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper Body Strength":
        warmup:
          treadmill_walk 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          seated_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          dumbbell_shoulder_press 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          upper_body_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Lower Body Controlled":
        warmup:
          stationary_bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press_partial_range 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          hamstring_curl_machine 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          calf_raise_machine 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_and_hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full Body & Core":
        warmup:
          elliptical 8m
        main straight_sets:
          cable_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          goblet_box_squat 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x30s rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 2x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          foam_roll_legs 5m
